name: Welcome to Shen'dar Village

angles.text: As a shaman, you can sense the faint static in the air around spirit-touched Windshapers like Illaya Amberwind in Shen'dar Village.

aliases: what to do in shendar village
faq.answer: Welcome to Shen'dar Village guides newcomers to meet the people who lead and serve the settlement. Travelers are directed to the resident Windshaper elder and the village innkeeper before they help with local troubles such as bandits.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the quest Welcome to Shen'dar Village?

faq.answer: Illaya Amberwind is Shen'dar Village's Windshaper elder. She is near the town center and guides those touched by the spirits amid local political friction.

aliases: where is the inn in shendar village
faq.answer: Coriella Calmbreeze runs Shen'dar Village's inn, offering lodging, rest, and provisions to travelers and locals.

The Windshapers are practitioners touched by the spirits, marked by a charge of static in the air around them. They and the High Order keep relations civil in Shen'dar Village despite their tensions and the wider threats.
The High Order and the Windshapers are in political and ideological conflict. In Shen'dar Village, both sides keep the peace and attend to shared, more urgent concerns.
faq.q: What is the tension between the High Order and the Windshapers?

faq.answer: Shen'dar Village faces local bandits in the surrounding territory, alongside the philosophical dispute between the Windshapers and the High Order.
faq.q: What problems is Shen'dar Village currently facing?

sections.body: Newcomers in Shen'dar Village first meet the people who guide daily life there. Those touched by the spirits are directed to Elder Illaya Amberwind near the village square. Coriella Calmbreeze welcomes visitors at the village inn, where lodging and supplies are available. These introductions help travelers learn the village's customs before they take up arms.
sections.title: First Steps in Shen'dar

sections.body: Disputes in Shen'dar Village stay civil, though the Windshapers and the High Order disagree. Their ideological friction runs through the region, but both groups know survival comes first. Bandits are pressing into the area. That danger gives the village reason to set smaller quarrels aside.
sections.title: Factions and Frontier Trouble

summary: At Shen'dar Village, newcomers are sent to meet its elder and innkeeper. Local tensions share the frontier with a growing bandit threat.
attribution: In-game quest text: Welcome to Shen'dar Village
